title: NOAA Global Drifter Program annual-mean surface velocity, 1-degree subset: the observed reference for scoring present-day currents (wwolf P02 step 1)
note: Laurindo, Mariano & Lumpkin (2017) climatology at 0.25 degrees, read through AOML's ERDDAP and thinned to every fourth point, so the 1-degree points sit on cell centres of the 0.25-degree grid (ECCO2's too). U and V in m/s at 15 m (drogued drifters), 72.875S-84.875N; cells without drifter data are missing. Used only by scripts/score_currents.py to score the ECCO2 mean the site draws at 0 Ma (and FOAM's 0 Ma run) in devlog wwolf 020; nothing is built from it or shipped. ERDDAP writes the request time into the file's history attribute, so a fresh download differs from this SHA-256 in that attribute only: compare U and V, not the bytes.

assets.cite: Laurindo, L. C., Mariano, A. J., & Lumpkin, R. (2017). An improved near-surface velocity climatology for the global ocean from drifter observations. Deep-Sea Research I, 124, 73-92. doi:10.1016/j.dsr.2017.04.009. Data: NOAA Global Drifter Program, https://www.aoml.noaa.gov/phod/gdp/
